description.value: The study investigated neural correlates of executive deficits by relating neuropsychological test performance to regional glucose utilization measured with FDG-PET in people with early dementia and prodromal stages, and compared metabolism among diagnostic groups.

spans.text: Our study examined the neural correlates of executive functions by correlating respective test scores with reductions in glucose utilization in early dementia and its prodromal stages.
